svg.aria-label: Panel A: refusal-direction SNR by layer for the attention and MLP writers of Qwen3.5-0.8B. Panel B: Target-Shift Calibration step size against activation norm on three models and on the 15-model H100 Stage-1 run, and the realized shift error
svg.text: SUB-STREAM SNR PROFILE (QWEN3.5-0.8B) · TARGET-SHIFT CALIBRATION (3 MODELS + 15-MODEL H100 STAGE-1)
Measure the writer before you edit it; let the measured scale set the step.
A: held-out SNR = (μ_pos − μ_neg) / σ_ctl of the B2 refusal direction at each layer, 5 + 5 held-out prompts, 10 controls.
B: β = |Δ_target| / ‖h_S‖₂², so ⟨q, ΔW·h_ref⟩ = Δ_target by construction at any width.
Refusal direction (B2) SNR by layer and writer, Qwen3.5-0.8B (24 layers)
full-attention layer (writer o_proj); unshaded = Gated DeltaNet (writer ssm_out)
A rule-of-thumb pick at about 60% depth (layer 15 of 24) lands on the weakest attention-block output in the stack. The MLP output
is 1.71 at layer 12 and 1.14 at layer 15. The root-cause direction (B3) peaks elsewhere (attention 17.86 at layer 11,
MLP 11.61 at layer 12), so the profile is per direction, not per model.
Target-Shift Calibration: the measured activation sets the step
‖h_S‖₂ (log), selected input columns at h_ref (64; Stage-1: 128)
Shift error at h_ref, per calibrated edit (|realized − Δ_target|)
Diamonds: the Qwen3.5-4B loop edits B1b (layer 8) and B1a (layer 13) at B1 dose 0.5x, 1.0x, 1.5x (bottom to top; B2, B3 held at 1.0x in every arm).
Same B3 target (|Δ| = 3.8956) on three models: ‖h_S‖ spans 4.13 to 10.44 (2.5x), so β spans 0.0358 to 0.2286 (6.4x). Every point sits on its own curve.
All 9 calibrated edits recompute to within 4.0e-15 of Δ_target in float64; storing the weights in BF16 moves the realized shift by 1.2e-06 to 2.0e-03.
Stage-1 (rings = B3, dots = B2): 15 models, 0.8B to 32.8B, |Δ| = 7.382, 128 columns. B2 ‖h_S‖ 1.41 to 15.91, β 0.0292 to 3.7192;
B3 ‖h_S‖ 2.53 to 27.47, β 0.0098 to 1.1508. Float64 shift error at h_ref ≤ 7.99e-15; the receipt has no BF16-storage witness and no behavioral benchmark.
The older 14-checkpoint H100 sweep (Regime C) used a fixed ratio (γ = 0.045·‖W‖_F), not this calibration.
